title: Power Apps: modern responsive template for canvas apps created from SharePoint lists
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap dates, template behaviour, data policy controls and general Power Apps licensing are supported. The cited documentation opened successfully, and targeted searches found no template-specific administrator switch, licensing terms or meter.

claims.claim: Microsoft plans an updated app-from-data experience for SharePoint and Microsoft Lists canvas apps.
claims.quote: the updated SharePoint/Microsoft Lists app-from-data experience gives makers responsive record browsing

claims.claim: The roadmap describes responsive record browsing with grid and list views.
claims.quote: responsive record browsing with grid and list views

claims.claim: The roadmap describes separate screens for creating and editing records.
claims.quote: plus separate screens for creating and editing records.

claims.where: What's changing; Why it matters; Risk assessment: Change & support; rationale: risk
claims.claim: The template creates a standalone canvas app rather than an embedded SharePoint customised form.
claims.quote: It creates a standalone canvas app, not an embedded SharePoint customized form.

claims.claim: The roadmap status is In development.
claims.quote: "status": "In development", "statusKey": "in-development"

claims.claim: The roadmap preview target is November CY2026.
claims.quote: "previewDate": "November CY2026"

claims.where: front matter: targetDate; What's changing; Open questions
claims.claim: The roadmap general availability target is February CY2027, not a committed release date.
claims.quote: "targetDate": "February CY2027", "status": "In development"

claims.where: front matter: clouds; What's changing; Scope
claims.claim: The roadmap lists Worldwide (Standard Multi-Tenant) as the cloud.
claims.quote: "clouds": ["Worldwide (Standard Multi-Tenant)"]

claims.where: front matter: platforms; What's changing; Scope
claims.claim: The roadmap lists Web as the platform.
claims.quote: "platforms": ["Web"]

claims.claim: The roadmap lists both General Availability and Preview as release phases.
claims.quote: "releasePhase": ["General Availability", "Preview"]

claims.claim: The roadmap describes public preview in early-release environments.
claims.quote: During public preview in early-release environments

claims.claim: The roadmap product is Power Apps.
claims.quote: "products": ["Power Apps"]

claims.claim: No other clouds are listed in the roadmap record.
claims.quote: "clouds": ["Worldwide (Standard Multi-Tenant)"]

claims.claim: The updated template uses responsive containers.
claims.quote: The updated template uses responsive containers, a modern Data Grid, and modern forms.

claims.claim: The updated template uses a modern Data Grid.
claims.quote: The updated template uses responsive containers, a modern Data Grid, and modern forms.

claims.claim: The updated template uses modern forms.
claims.quote: The updated template uses responsive containers, a modern Data Grid, and modern forms.

claims.claim: The generated app layout depends on the template available in the maker's environment.
claims.quote: The layout depends on the template available in your environment.

claims.claim: Learn also describes a responsive single-screen template combining browsing and editing.
claims.quote: The responsive single-screen template combines browsing and record editing on one screen.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; What's changing; Why it matters; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft has not stated which template an environment receives by default or its arrival behaviour.
claims.quote: Searched: SharePoint canvas app updated modern responsive template admin enable disable default environment rollout existing apps identity permissions. Opened app-from-sharepoint; read roadmap. Neither specifies the default template assignment or automatic arrival behaviour.

claims.claim: A view switch on the records screen selects grid or list view.
claims.quote: Use the view switch on the records screen to choose a grid or a list

claims.claim: Grid view presents records in columns.
claims.quote: Grid | Review records in columns and select rows.

claims.claim: The grid edit action appears when exactly one row is selected.
claims.quote: The edit action appears when you select exactly one row.

claims.claim: List view presents a compact list whose items open their details.
claims.quote: List | Review a compact list and open an item to view its details.

claims.claim: The new-record form uses one column below app width 768.
claims.quote: The new-record form uses one column below an app width of `768`

claims.claim: The new-record form uses two columns at app widths of 768 or greater.
claims.quote: two columns at widths of `768` or greater.

claims.claim: The app-from-list Learn page does not mark itself as preview.
claims.quote: Searched: app-from-sharepoint responsive template Data Grid modern forms. Opened app-from-sharepoint in full: title is 'Create a canvas app with data from a list'; no preview designation or prerelease banner appears.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Data exposure; rationale: risk
claims.claim: The generated app connects to the list the maker selects.
claims.quote: Select a list or select the sample list you created earlier, and then select Create app. ... When you create the app, Power Apps Studio opens with a generated app connected to your list.

claims.claim: Adding or editing information in the app updates the SharePoint or Lists source.
claims.quote: When you add or edit information in the app, the information in SharePoint or Lists also updates.

claims.claim: Data access depends on source permissions and connections rather than the generated visual template.
claims.quote: you must also manage permissions for the data source or sources on which the app is based ... You might also need to share other resources on which the app depends, such as flows, gateways, or connections.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Grid view filters a generated collection.
claims.quote: Grid view filters a generated collection, while list view filters the connected data source.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance guidance
claims.claim: List view filters the connected data source.
claims.quote: Grid view filters a generated collection, while list view filters the connected data source.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Grid and list filters can produce different records on a large list.
claims.quote: Grid view filters a generated collection, while list view filters the connected data source. Check the same filter in both views after you connect your list. Generated counts and collection-backed results don't guarantee that every record in a large list is loaded.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: Microsoft asks makers to check the same filter in both views.
claims.quote: Check the same filter in both views after you connect your list. ... Apply a filter and check that both views show the expected records.

claims.where: Why it matters; Governance guidance: After rollout
claims.claim: Generated counts and collection-backed results do not guarantee all records in a large list are loaded.
claims.quote: Generated counts and collection-backed results don't guarantee that every record in a large list is loaded.

claims.where: Why it matters; Governance guidance; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Connector and formula delegation limits still apply.
claims.quote: Connector and formula delegation limits still apply.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Microsoft describes no new identity, permission or data-access model for this template.
claims.quote: Searched: "app-from-sharepoint" "template" "identity" "autonomous". Opened app-from-sharepoint and share-app; read roadmap. No new identity, permission or data-access model is described.

claims.claim: The generated standalone canvas app uses normal Power Apps sharing.
claims.quote: When you create a canvas app, you can define which users in your organization can use the app, modify it, and even re-share it.

claims.where: Why it matters; controls[0].governs; Governance controls
claims.claim: General Power Apps data policies govern connector combinations for apps in their environment scope, including SharePoint.
claims.quote: After this policy is saved, any Power Apps or Power Automate maker, who is part of the data policy's environment, can create an app or a flow that shares data between SharePoint or Salesforce.

claims.claim: The walkthrough's Business assignment prevents combining SharePoint with Non-business or Blocked connectors.
claims.quote: By moving the Salesforce and SharePoint connectors to the Business data group, you're preventing users from creating flows and apps that combine these two connectors with any of the connectors in the Non-business or Blocked groups.

claims.where: controls[0].note; Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance controls
claims.claim: Microsoft documents no template-specific variation of the general connector data policy rules.
claims.quote: Searched: SharePoint canvas app updated modern responsive template admin enable disable default environment rollout existing apps identity permissions. Opened app-from-sharepoint and prevent-data-loss. General app rules cover this class; neither names a special rule for the updated template.

claims.claim: No autonomous or agent behaviour is described for the template.
claims.quote: Searched: "app-from-sharepoint" "template" "identity" "autonomous". Opened app-from-sharepoint in full and read roadmap; the documented actions are browsing and user-operated record forms, with no autonomous or agent behaviour described.

claims.claim: People use form screens to create or edit records.
claims.quote: Use the new-record action to open the form screen for a new item. Use a list item or the grid's edit action to open an existing record.

claims.claim: The save action calls SubmitForm on the generated form.
claims.quote: Its save action calls `SubmitForm` on the generated form.

claims.claim: The form's OnFailure action shows an error notification.
claims.quote: Its OnFailure action shows an error notification.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: Microsoft advises preserving the generated DataSource unless its behaviour is intentionally replaced.
claims.quote: preserve the generated DataSource, Item, navigation formulas, and form success and failure actions unless you intentionally replace their behavior.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: Microsoft advises preserving the generated Item unless its behaviour is intentionally replaced.
claims.quote: preserve the generated DataSource, Item, navigation formulas, and form success and failure actions unless you intentionally replace their behavior.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: Microsoft advises preserving generated navigation formulas unless their behaviour is intentionally replaced.
claims.quote: preserve the generated DataSource, Item, navigation formulas, and form success and failure actions unless you intentionally replace their behavior.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: Microsoft advises preserving form success and failure actions unless their behaviour is intentionally replaced.
claims.quote: preserve the generated DataSource, Item, navigation formulas, and form success and failure actions unless you intentionally replace their behavior.

claims.claim: Generated control and screen names can vary, so older tutorial names may not match.
claims.quote: The generated control and screen names can vary, so use the names in your app rather than names from an older tutorial.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: Microsoft has not published template-specific licensing terms.
claims.quote: Searched: SharePoint modern responsive canvas app template licensing pricing meter template-specific. Opened app-from-sharepoint, powerapps-licensing-faq and pricing-billing-skus. General Power Apps terms are published; no separate terms for this template were found.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: Building canvas apps does not require a licence.
claims.quote: You don't need a license to build canvas apps. You need a license to build model-driven apps.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: Running apps requires appropriate Power Apps entitlements.
claims.quote: Power Apps requires users to have an appropriate license to run apps

claims.claim: Some Microsoft 365 licences include Power Apps use rights for Microsoft 365 data and standard connectors.
claims.quote: Some Microsoft 365 licenses include limited Power Apps and Power Automate use rights. These use rights are intended for scenarios that use Microsoft 365 data and standard connectors.

claims.claim: Premium capabilities can require additional entitlements.
claims.quote: Some examples of features that require premium entitlements include: premium connectors, Dataverse entities, on-premises data gateways, custom APIs, etc.

claims.claim: Managed Environments can require additional qualifying entitlements, including for standard apps.
claims.quote: When you activate managed environments in an environment, all active usage requires a qualifying license ... This requirement includes users who run standard apps

claims.claim: The app-from-list page's prerequisite is SharePoint and Power Apps with a Microsoft 365 and Microsoft Power Platform subscription.
claims.quote: Use SharePoint and Power Apps with a subscription to Microsoft 365 and Microsoft Power Platform.

claims.claim: Those feature-page prerequisites name no specific plan.
claims.quote: Prerequisites: Use SharePoint and Power Apps with a subscription to Microsoft 365 and Microsoft Power Platform.

claims.claim: Microsoft documents no separate template-specific meter.
claims.quote: Searched: SharePoint modern responsive canvas app template licensing pricing meter template-specific. Opened app-from-sharepoint, pricing-billing-skus and pay-as-you-go-meters. The meter table and Power Apps subsection describe the general per-app meter, not a template-specific meter.

claims.claim: The general Power Apps per-app pay-as-you-go meter can apply to generated canvas apps where Power Apps pay-as-you-go is enabled.
claims.quote: The Power Apps per-app meter provides access to both canvas, and model-driven apps for authenticated users.

claims.claim: Pay-as-you-go charges are billed through the linked Azure subscription.
claims.quote: When you choose to use pay-as-you-go, Azure meters bill your Azure subscription for your usage of Power Platform services.

claims.claim: The published Power Apps per-app meter rate is $10 per active user/app/month.
claims.quote: Power Apps per-app ... $10 per active user/app/month

claims.claim: Users with Power Apps per-user licences are not counted in the per-app meter.
claims.quote: If a user has a Power Apps per-user license, the user isn't counted in the meter.

claims.claim: Users with qualifying Microsoft 365 Power Apps rights using standard-connector apps are not counted in the meter.
claims.quote: If a user has a Microsoft 365 license, which provides access to Power Apps and is using an app with standard connectors, the user is also not counted in the meter.

claims.claim: The roadmap record states no licensing terms.
claims.quote: Description ends: 'Connector and formula delegation limits still apply.' The supplied record contains no licensing or pricing field or statement.

claims.where: controls[0].ui; Governance controls table and prose
claims.claim: Data policy is under Power Platform admin center > Security > Settings > Data and privacy > Data policy.
claims.quote: Select Security in the navigation pane. ... In the Security pane, under Settings, select Data and privacy. ... In the Data protection and privacy screen, select the Data policy section.

claims.where: controls[0].api; Governance controls table and prose
claims.claim: New-DlpPolicy -NewPolicy $NewPolicy in Microsoft.PowerApps.Administration.PowerShell creates a policy from a policy object.
claims.quote: Module: Microsoft.PowerApps.Administration.PowerShell Module. ... New-DlpPolicy -NewPolicy $NewPolicy ... Creates a new policy with the `$NewPolicy` object.

claims.where: controls[1].ui and controls[1].api; summary; Governance controls
claims.claim: No template-specific tenant or environment enable/disable control is documented on the admin UI or automation surfaces.
claims.quote: Searched: SharePoint app-from-data modern template Power Platform API CLI pac admin PowerShell enable disable template. Opened app-from-sharepoint; read pac admin search excerpts and the UI/default search results. No template-specific switch found.

claims.claim: Get-DlpPolicy retrieves existing data policy objects.
claims.quote: The Get-DlpPolicy cmdlet retrieves policy objects for the logged in admin's tenant.

claims.claim: Makers can start the app in Power Apps using Start with data > SharePoint.
claims.quote: From the home screen, select Start with data. ... On the Create an app page, select SharePoint.

claims.claim: Makers can start the app from a SharePoint or Lists list using Integrate > Power Apps > Create an app.
claims.quote: Open a list in either SharePoint or Lists. ... Select Integrate > Power Apps > Create an app.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not stated the detailed assignment or rollout mechanics for other environments.
claims.quote: Searched: "app-from-sharepoint" "template" "existing" "rollout". Opened app-from-sharepoint; read roadmap and the environment/default search results. No assignment schedule or rollout mechanics beyond the roadmap's early-release preview were found.

claims.claim: No source examined says that this template update changes existing generated apps.
claims.quote: Searched: "app-from-sharepoint" "template" "existing" "rollout". Opened app-from-sharepoint; read roadmap. Neither specifies migration or conversion of existing generated apps. Results about existing customised SharePoint forms concern a different feature.

claims.where: Cost and licensing; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: Microsoft's pre-sharing checks include previewing both views at narrow and wide widths.
claims.quote: Before sharing the generated app: 1. Preview both grid and list views at narrow and wide widths.

claims.where: Cost and licensing; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: Microsoft's pre-sharing checks include creating and saving a test record and checking it in the source list.
claims.quote: Create a test record, save it, and confirm the values in the source list.

claims.where: Cost and licensing; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: Microsoft's pre-sharing checks include editing the test record and checking the changes in the source list.
claims.quote: Open that record, edit it, and confirm the changes in the source list.

claims.claim: The licensing model is mixed, reflecting general included use rights, standalone licences and pay-as-you-go options.
claims.quote: Microsoft Power Platform capabilities can be licensed through standalone licenses, use rights included with other Microsoft products, capacity add-ons, or pay-as-you-go meters.

claims.claim: Other users see the maker's generated app changes after the maker publishes them.
claims.quote: Whenever you make changes, you must save and publish the app again if you want others to see those changes.
